segments.tr: ينبغي للقراء مراجعة التغطية الإخبارية الحالية من المؤسسات الإخبارية المعتمدة لمعرفة أحدث المستجدات.*

fr.title: Un accord sur le papier, un face-à-face sur le terrain : le compte à rebours de 14 jours est lancé pour le désarmement de Gaza

segments.src: Signing is the easy part.
segments.tr: Signer est la partie la plus facile.

segments.src: The framework agreed to by Hamas and other Palestinian factions does something narrower — and more consequential — than end a conflict: it converts an open-ended question into a scheduled one.
segments.tr: Le cadre accepté par le Hamas et d'autres factions palestiniennes fait quelque chose de plus restreint — et de plus lourd de conséquences — que de mettre fin à un conflit : il transforme une question ouverte en un calendrier programmé.

segments.src: Weapons are to be handed to a new Gaza administration rather than surrendered to Israel.
segments.tr: Les armes doivent être remises à une nouvelle administration de Gaza plutôt que cédées à Israel.

segments.src: Israeli withdrawal is to be traded, in stages, against verified disarmament over roughly seven to eight months.
segments.tr: Le retrait israélien doit être négocié, par étapes, en échange d'un désarmement vérifié sur une période d'environ sept à huit mois.

segments.src: And the parties have given themselves about two weeks to produce the detailed roadmap that says how any of that actually works.
segments.tr: Et les parties se sont donné environ deux semaines pour élaborer la feuille de route détaillée expliquant comment tout cela fonctionnera concrètement.

segments.src: That 14-day window, not the signing ceremony, is where the agreement will be tested first.
segments.tr: C'est ce délai de 14 jours, et non la cérémonie de signature, qui constituera le premier véritable test de l'accord.

segments.src: ## What the framework commits to — and what it deliberately leaves open
segments.tr: ## Ce à quoi le cadre s'engage — et ce qu'il laisse délibérément en suspens

segments.src: Read plainly, the document establishes four things:
segments.tr: Lequel document établit clairement quatre choses :

segments.src: - **A recipient for the weapons.** Arms are to be transferred to a new Palestinian administrative body in Gaza, not to Israeli forces or to a foreign military.
segments.tr: - **Un destinataire pour les armes.** Les armes doivent être transférées à un nouvel organe administratif palestinien à Gaza, et non aux forces israéliennes ou à une armée étrangère.

segments.src: - **A trade structure.** Israeli withdrawal is sequenced against disarmament that a third party certifies, rather than either step happening unilaterally.
segments.tr: - **Une structure d'échange.** Le retrait israélien est échelonné en fonction d'un désarmement certifié par une tierce partie, plutôt que de voir l'une ou l'autre étape s'effectuer de manière unilatérale.

segments.src: - **A horizon.** Seven to eight months for the full process, which is fast by the standards of comparable disarmament efforts and slow by the standards of the political pressure on both sides.
segments.tr: - **Un horizon.** Sept à huit mois pour l'ensemble du processus, ce qui est rapide par rapport aux normes des efforts de désarmement comparables et lent par rapport à la pression politique s'exerçant sur les deux parties.

segments.src: - **A deadline for detail.** A concrete implementation roadmap within roughly 14 days.
segments.tr: - **Une date limite pour les détails.** Une feuille de route de mise en œuvre concrète dans un délai d'environ 14 jours.

segments.src: What it does not settle is nearly everything that determines whether the first three hold.
segments.tr: Ce qu'il ne règle pas, c'est presque tout ce qui détermine si les trois premiers points tiendront.

segments.src: Frameworks are written to be signable; roadmaps have to be executable.
segments.tr: Les cadres sont rédigés pour être signables ; les feuilles de route doivent être exécutables.

segments.src: The gap between those two documents is where most disarmament agreements historically fail.
segments.tr: C'est dans l'écart entre ces deux documents que la plupart des accords de désarmement échouent historiquement.

segments.src: The choice of recipient is the clearest example of a compromise that postpones a fight rather than resolving it.
segments.tr: Le choix du destinataire est l'exemple le plus clair d'un compromis qui reporte un affrontement plutôt que de le résoudre.

segments.src: Handing weapons to a Palestinian body lets the factions describe the process as a transfer of national assets rather than a capitulation — politically survivable for a movement that has built its identity on armed resistance.
segments.tr: Remettre des armes à un organe palestinien permet aux factions de décrire le processus comme un transfert d'actifs nationaux plutôt que comme une capitulation — ce qui est politiquement acceptable pour un mouvement qui a bâti son identité sur la résistance armée.

segments.src: For Israel, the same arrangement raises the obvious objection: a transfer is only meaningful if the receiving institution is genuinely independent of the group doing the transferring, and genuinely capable of keeping custody.
segments.tr: Pour Israel, ce même arrangement soulève une objection évidente : un transfert n'a de sens que si l'institution destinataire est véritablement indépendante du groupe qui effectue le transfert, et véritablement capable d'en assurer la garde.

segments.src: ## Six questions the roadmap has to answer
segments.tr: ## Six questions auxquelles la feuille de route doit répondre

segments.src: If the two-week document is serious, it will have to be specific where the framework is not:
segments.tr: Si le document attendu sous deux semaines est sérieux, il devra être précis là où le cadre ne l'est pas :

segments.src: 1. **What counts as a weapon.** Rockets and launchers are the headline category, but the harder items are production workshops, drone components, dual-use machine tools, and the tunnel infrastructure that gives any of it strategic value. An inventory limited to visible hardware is a much smaller commitment than one that includes manufacturing capacity.
segments.tr: 1. **Ce qui compte comme une arme.** Les roquettes et les lanceurs constituent la catégorie principale, mais les éléments les plus difficiles sont les ateliers de production, les composants de drones, les machines-outils à double usage et l'infrastructure de tunnels qui donne à l'ensemble une valeur stratégique. Un inventaire limité au matériel visible est un engagement bien moindre qu'un inventaire incluant la capacité de fabrication.

segments.src: 2. **Who physically takes custody.** Sealed storage under monitoring, destruction on site, or removal from the territory are three very different outcomes with very different reversibility.
segments.tr: 2. **Qui prend physiquement la garde.** Le stockage scellé sous surveillance, la destruction sur place ou le retrait du territoire sont trois résultats très différents avec des niveaux de réversibilité très différents.

segments.src: 3. **Who verifies, and with what access.** Verification is only as good as the monitors' freedom of movement and their acceptance by both parties. A body one side considers biased produces certifications the other side will not act on.
segments.tr: 3. **Qui vérifie, et avec quel accès.** La vérification ne vaut que par la liberté de mouvement des observateurs et leur acceptation par les deux parties. Un organe qu'une partie considère comme partial produit des certifications sur lesquelles l'autre partie n'agira pas.

segments.src: 4. **What each Israeli withdrawal line is keyed to.** Withdrawal tied to calendar dates behaves very differently from withdrawal tied to certified milestones — and each side has reason to prefer a different trigger.
segments.tr: 4. **À quoi chaque ligne de retrait israélien est liée.** Un retrait lié à des dates calendaires se comporte très différemment d'un retrait lié à des étapes certifiées — et chaque partie a des raisons de préférer un déclencheur différent.

segments.src: 5. **What happens to the fighters, not just the guns.** Demobilization programs that lack a livelihood or a policing role for former combatants tend to leak personnel into whatever armed structure remains. Any credible plan needs an answer on vetting, salaries, and legal status.
segments.tr: 5. **Ce qu'il advient des combattants, et pas seulement des armes.** Les programmes de démobilisation qui ne proposent pas de moyens de subsistance ou de rôle de maintien de l'ordre pour les anciens combattants ont tendance à laisser fuiter le personnel vers n'importe quelle structure armée restante. Tout plan crédible doit apporter une réponse sur la vérification des antécédents, les salaires et le statut juridique.

segments.src: 6. **What non-compliance costs.** The hardest clause to draft is the one that penalizes a violation without handing either party a pretext to abandon the whole arrangement.
segments.tr: 6. **Ce que coûte le non-respect.** La clause la plus difficile à rédiger est celle qui pénalise une violation sans donner à l'une ou l'autre des parties un prétexte pour abandonner l'ensemble de l'accord.

segments.src: ## The sequencing problem is not a detail — it is the deal
segments.tr: ## Le problème du séquençage n'est pas un détail — c'est le cœur de l'accord

segments.src: Both sides are currently insisting the other move first, and both have a coherent reason.
segments.tr: Les deux parties insistent actuellement pour que l'autre fasse le premier pas, et toutes deux ont une raison cohérente.

segments.src: The Israeli argument is about capability: territory returned before weapons are verifiably gone can be used to reconstitute, and reconstitution is precisely what a disarmament agreement is supposed to prevent.
segments.tr: L'argument israélien porte sur la capacité : un territoire restitué avant que les armes n'aient disparu de manière vérifiable peut être utilisé pour se reconstituer, et la reconstitution est précisément ce qu'un accord de désarmement est censé empêcher.

segments.src: The Palestinian argument is about leverage: arms handed over before withdrawal is complete removes the only guarantee the factions hold that the remaining stages will be honored at all.
segments.tr: L'argument palestinien porte sur le levier de négociation : céder des armes avant que le retrait ne soit complet supprime la seule garantie dont disposent les factions que les étapes restantes seront effectivement honorées.

segments.src: Neither position is unreasonable, which is exactly what makes it a security dilemma rather than a negotiating tactic.
segments.tr: Aucune des deux positions n'est irraisonnable, ce qui en fait précisément un dilemme de sécurité plutôt qu'une simple tactique de négociation.

segments.src: Agreements that have gotten past this point generally used the same toolkit: break the exchange into many small reciprocal steps so no single move is decisive; place weapons with a third party rather than with the adversary; put monitors on the ground early enough that both sides trust the reporting; and define milestones narrowly enough that compliance is a matter of observation rather than interpretation.
segments.tr: Les accords qui ont dépassé ce stade ont généralement utilisé la même boîte à outils : diviser l'échange en de nombreuses petites étapes réciproques afin qu'aucune mesure prise isolément ne soit décisive ; confier les armes à une tierce partie plutôt qu'à l'adversaire ; placer des observateurs sur le terrain suffisamment tôt pour que les deux parties fassent confiance aux rapports ; et définir les étapes de manière suffisamment étroite pour que la conformité soit une question d'observation plutôt que d'interprétation.

segments.src: Whether the roadmap uses that toolkit is the single most informative thing that will emerge in the next two weeks.
segments.tr: Savoir si la feuille de route utilise cette boîte à outils est l'élément d'information le plus révélateur qui émergera au cours des deux prochaines semaines.

segments.src: ## What "verified disarmament" has meant elsewhere
segments.tr: ## Ce que le "désarmement vérifié" a signifié ailleurs

segments.src: Comparisons are imperfect, but the record is instructive.
segments.tr: Les comparaisons sont imparfaites, mais les précédents sont instructifs.

segments.src: In Northern Ireland, an independent decommissioning commission operated for roughly a decade.
segments.tr: En Irlande du Nord, une commission indépendante de neutralisation des armes a fonctionné pendant environ une décennie.

segments.src: Deadlines slipped repeatedly, and the process ultimately worked partly because the commission was permitted to confirm that decommissioning had occurred without publishing a full inventory — a deliberate ambiguity that let the armed group avoid the appearance of surrender.
segments.tr: Les délais ont été manqués à plusieurs reprises, et le processus a finalement fonctionné en partie parce que la commission a été autorisée à confirmer que le désarmement avait eu lieu sans publier d'inventaire complet — une ambiguïté délibérée qui a permis au groupe armé d'éviter l'apparence d'une reddition.

segments.src: In Colombia, a UN mission collected and destroyed FARC weapons on a timeline measured in months rather than years.
segments.tr: En Colombie, une mission de l'ONU a collecté et détruit les armes des FARC selon un calendrier mesuré en mois plutôt qu'en années.

segments.src: It benefited from conditions that do not obviously apply in Gaza: a single unified command that could order compliance, a negotiated political pathway for former combatants, and a monitoring mission both parties had accepted in advance.
segments.tr: Elle a bénéficié de conditions qui ne s'appliquent pas de toute évidence à Gaza : un commandement unique et unifié capable d'ordonner le respect des engagements, une voie politique négociée pour les anciens combattants et une mission d'observation acceptée au préalable par les deux parties.

segments.src: Lebanon offers the cautionary case: repeated formal commitments to disarm non-state actors that were never implemented, largely because no institution existed with both the authority and the incentive to enforce them.
segments.tr: Le Liban offre un cas d'école avertisseur : des engagements formels répétés de désarmer les acteurs non étatiques qui n'ont jamais été mis en œuvre, principalement parce qu'aucune institution n'existait avec à la fois l'autorité et l'incitation nécessaires pour les faire respecter.

segments.src: The pattern across all three is consistent.
segments.tr: Le schéma à travers ces trois exemples est constant.

segments.src: Verified disarmament tends to succeed where there is a single chain of command that can deliver compliance, a political and economic future for the people being disarmed, monitors accepted by both sides before the clock starts, and enough face-saving ambiguity that compliance is not experienced as humiliation.
segments.tr: Le désarmement vérifié tend à réussir lorsqu'il existe une chaîne de commandement unique capable de faire respecter les engagements, un avenir politique et économique pour les personnes désarmées, des observateurs acceptés par les deux parties avant que le compte à rebours ne commence, et suffisamment d'ambiguïté pour sauver la face afin que le respect de l'accord ne soit pas vécu comme une humiliation.

segments.src: It tends to fail where the receiving institution is weaker than the group handing over the weapons.
segments.tr: Il a tendance à échouer lorsque l'institution destinataire est plus faible que le groupe qui remet les armes.

segments.src: ## The fragmentation risk
segments.tr: ## Le risque de fragmentation

segments.src: A framework signed by the major factions is not the same as compliance by every armed actor.
segments.tr: Un cadre signé par les principales factions n'est pas synonyme de respect par chaque acteur armé.

segments.src: Gaza's landscape includes smaller groups, family and clan structures with their own weapons, and criminal networks that have expanded during a prolonged breakdown of civil order.
segments.tr: Le paysage de Gaza comprend des groupes plus restreints, des structures familiales et claniques possédant leurs propres armes, ainsi que des réseaux criminels qui se sont développés au cours d'une rupture prolongée de l'ordre civil.

segments.src: Some of these actors have no signature on the document and no stake in it.
segments.tr: Certains de ces acteurs n'ont aucune signature sur le document et aucun intérêt à y adhérer.

segments.src: A roadmap that treats "the weapons" as a single inventory held by a single authority may not match conditions on the ground.
segments.tr: Une feuille de route qui traite « les armes » comme un inventaire unique détenu par une autorité unique peut ne pas correspondre à la réalité du terrain.

segments.src: That mismatch matters because it creates a predictable dispute later: incidents involving unaffiliated actors can be read by one side as evidence of bad faith and by the other as proof that the framework was never enforceable.
segments.tr: Ce décalage est important car il crée un litige prévisible par la suite : les incidents impliquant des acteurs non affiliés peuvent être interprétés par une partie comme une preuve de mauvaise foi et par l'autre comme la preuve que le cadre n'a jamais été applicable.

segments.src: Roadmaps that anticipate this — by distinguishing organized stockpiles from diffuse small arms, and by setting realistic expectations for the latter — are considerably more durable than ones that do not.
segments.tr: Les feuilles de route qui anticipent cela — en distinguant les stocks organisés des armes légères dispersées, et en fixant des attentes réalistes pour ces dernières — sont considérablement plus durables que celles qui ne le font pas.

segments.src: ## What to watch over the next two weeks
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller au cours des deux prochaines semaines

segments.src: - Whether the roadmap is published at all, or whether the deadline slips without a new date attached.
segments.tr: - Si la feuille de route est publiée ou non, ou si le délai glisse sans qu'une nouvelle date ne soit fixée.

segments.src: - Whether it names the verification body and describes its access rights, or defers that question again.
segments.tr: - Si elle nomme l'organe de vérification et décrit ses droits d'accès, ou si elle reporte à nouveau cette question.

segments.src: - Whether the new Gaza administration is given identifiable staffing, funding, and a defined relationship to existing Palestinian institutions.
segments.tr: - Si la nouvelle administration de Gaza se voit attribuer du personnel identifiable, un financement et une relation définie avec les institutions palestiniennes existantes.

segments.src: - Whether disarmament milestones are tied to specific withdrawal lines on a map.
segments.tr: - Si les étapes du désarmement sont liées à des lignes de retrait spécifiques sur une carte.

segments.src: - Whether any confidence-building step happens early — a first handover, a first pullback — before the full document is finalized. Small early moves are the most reliable predictor that a sequencing standoff will break.
segments.tr: - Si une mesure de confiance est prise rapidement — une première remise d'armes, un premier retrait — avant que le document complet ne soit finalisé. Les petits gestes précoces sont l'indicateur le plus fiable qu'un blocage sur le séquençage sera surmonté.

segments.src: - Whether the language distinguishes heavy weapons from small arms. Frameworks that promise total disarmament tend to collapse; ones that prioritize strategic capability tend to survive.
segments.tr: - Si la formulation distingue les armes lourdes des armes légères. Les cadres qui promettent un désarmement total ont tendance à s'effondrer ; ceux qui priorisent les capacités stratégiques ont tendance à survivre.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En conclusion

segments.src: The framework's real achievement is that it replaced an argument about whether disarmament happens with an argument about how and in what order.
segments.tr: La véritable réussite du cadre est d'avoir remplacé un débat sur l'opportunité du désarmement par un débat sur ses modalités et son ordre de déroulement.

segments.src: That is genuine progress, and it is also where the difficulty concentrates.
segments.tr: C'est un véritable progrès, et c'est aussi là que se concentre la difficulté.

segments.src: Seven to eight months is an ambitious schedule for a process that has taken years elsewhere under easier conditions, and the two-week roadmap deadline is the first honest test of whether the parties are negotiating implementation or still negotiating position.
segments.tr: Sept à huit mois est un calendrier ambitieux pour un processus qui a pris des années ailleurs dans des conditions plus faciles, et le délai de deux semaines pour la feuille de route est le premier test honnête pour savoir si les parties négocient la mise en œuvre ou négocient encore leurs positions.

segments.src: If the roadmap arrives on time and names a verifier, the deal is being built.
segments.tr: Si la feuille de route arrive à temps et nomme un vérificateur, l'accord est en train de se construire.

segments.src: If it arrives late, vague, or not at all, the framework will have documented the disagreement rather than resolved it.
segments.tr: Si elle arrive en retard, floue, ou pas du tout, le cadre aura pris acte du désaccord plutôt qu'il ne l'aura résolu.

segments.src: *This is an evolving diplomatic process, and specific terms, timelines, and participants may change as negotiations continue.
segments.tr: *Il s'agit d'un processus diplomatique évolutif, et les termes spécifiques, les calendriers et les participants peuvent changer à mesure que les négociations se poursuivent.

segments.src: Readers should consult current reporting from established news organizations for the latest developments.*
segments.tr: Les lecteurs sont invités à consulter les informations actuelles des organes de presse reconnus pour suivre les derniers développements.*

pt.title: Um Acordo no Papel, um Impasse no Terreno: O Relógio de 14 Dias Agora em Andamento sobre o Desarmamento de Gaza

segments.tr: Assinar é a parte fácil.

segments.tr: O arcabouço acordado pelo Hamas e outras facções palestinas faz algo mais restrito — e mais consequente — do que encerrar um conflito: ele converte uma questão em aberto em uma questão agendada.

segments.tr: As armas devem ser entregues a uma nova administração de Gaza, em vez de serem entregues a Israel.

segments.tr: A retirada israelense deve ser trocada, em etapas, por um desarmamento verificado ao longo de aproximadamente sete a oito meses.

segments.tr: E as partes se deram cerca de duas semanas para produzir o roteiro detalhado que especifica como tudo isso realmente funcionará.

segments.src: That 14-day window, not the signing ceremony, is where the agreement will be tested first.
segments.tr: Essa janela de 14 dias, e não a cerimônia de assinatura, é onde o acordo será testado primeiro.

segments.src: ## What the framework commits to — and what it deliberately leaves open
segments.tr: ## O que o arcabouço compromete — e o que deixa deliberadamente em aberto

segments.src: Read plainly, the document establishes four things:

segments.src: - **A recipient for the weapons.** Arms are to be transferred to a new Palestinian administrative body in Gaza, not to Israeli forces or to a foreign military.
segments.tr: - **Um destinatário para as armas.** As armas devem ser transferidas para um novo órgão administrativo palestino em Gaza, e não para as forças israelenses ou para um exército estrangeiro.

segments.src: - **A trade structure.** Israeli withdrawal is sequenced against disarmament that a third party certifies, rather than either step happening unilaterally.
segments.tr: - **Uma estrutura de troca.** A retirada israelense é sequenciada em relação ao desarmamento certificado por terceiros, em vez de qualquer uma das etapas ocorrer de forma unilateral.

segments.src: - **A horizon.** Seven to eight months for the full process, which is fast by the standards of comparable disarmament efforts and slow by the standards of the political pressure on both sides.
segments.tr: - **Um horizonte.** Sete a oito meses para o processo completo, o que é rápido para os padrões de esforços de desarmamento comparáveis e lento para os padrões da pressão política em ambos os lados.

segments.src: - **A deadline for detail.** A concrete implementation roadmap within roughly 14 days.
segments.tr: - **Um prazo para detalhes.** Um roteiro de implementação concreto em aproximadamente 14 dias.

segments.src: What it does not settle is nearly everything that determines whether the first three hold.
segments.tr: O que ele não resolve é quase tudo o que determina se os três primeiros pontos se sustentam.

segments.src: Frameworks are written to be signable; roadmaps have to be executable.
segments.tr: Arcabouços são escritos para serem assinados; roteiros precisam ser executáveis.

segments.src: The gap between those two documents is where most disarmament agreements historically fail.
segments.tr: O fosso entre esses dois documentos é onde a maioria dos acordos de desarmamento historicamente falha.

segments.src: The choice of recipient is the clearest example of a compromise that postpones a fight rather than resolving it.
segments.tr: A escolha do destinatário é o exemplo mais claro de um compromisso que adiaria uma briga em vez de resolvê-la.

segments.src: Handing weapons to a Palestinian body lets the factions describe the process as a transfer of national assets rather than a capitulation — politically survivable for a movement that has built its identity on armed resistance.
segments.tr: Entregar armas a um órgão palestino permite que as facções descrevam o processo como uma transferência de ativos nacionais em vez de uma capitulação — politicamente viável para um movimento que construiu sua identidade na resistência armada.

segments.src: For Israel, the same arrangement raises the obvious objection: a transfer is only meaningful if the receiving institution is genuinely independent of the group doing the transferring, and genuinely capable of keeping custody.
segments.tr: Para Israel, a mesma disposição levanta a objeção óbvia: uma transferência só é significativa se a instituição receptora for verdadeiramente independente do grupo que faz a transferência e verdadeiramente capaz de manter a custódia.

segments.src: ## Six questions the roadmap has to answer
segments.tr: ## Seis perguntas que o roteiro precisa responder

segments.src: If the two-week document is serious, it will have to be specific where the framework is not:
segments.tr: Se o documento de duas semanas for sério, ele terá que ser específico onde o arcabouço não é:

segments.src: 1. **What counts as a weapon.** Rockets and launchers are the headline category, but the harder items are production workshops, drone components, dual-use machine tools, and the tunnel infrastructure that gives any of it strategic value. An inventory limited to visible hardware is a much smaller commitment than one that includes manufacturing capacity.
segments.tr: 1. **O que conta como arma.** Foguetes e lançadores são a categoria principal, mas os itens mais difíceis são as oficinas de produção, componentes de drones, máquinas-ferramentas de duplo uso e a infraestrutura de túneis que dá a qualquer um desses itens valor estratégico. Um inventário limitado a equipamentos visíveis é um compromisso muito menor do que um que inclua a capacidade de fabricação.

segments.src: 2. **Who physically takes custody.** Sealed storage under monitoring, destruction on site, or removal from the territory are three very different outcomes with very different reversibility.
segments.tr: 2. **Quem assume fisicamente a custódia.** Armazenamento selado sob monitoramento, destruição no local ou remoção do território são três resultados muito diferentes, com reversibilidades muito diferentes.

segments.src: 3. **Who verifies, and with what access.** Verification is only as good as the monitors' freedom of movement and their acceptance by both parties. A body one side considers biased produces certifications the other side will not act on.
segments.tr: 3. **Quem verifica, e com qual nível de acesso.** A verificação é tão boa quanto a liberdade de movimento dos observadores e sua aceitação por ambas as partes. Um órgão que um dos lados considera parcial produz certificações sobre as quais o outro lado não agirá.

segments.src: 4. **What each Israeli withdrawal line is keyed to.** Withdrawal tied to calendar dates behaves very differently from withdrawal tied to certified milestones — and each side has reason to prefer a different trigger.
segments.tr: 4. **A que se vincula cada linha de retirada israelense.** A retirada vinculada a datas do calendário se comporta de maneira muito diferente da retirada vinculada a marcos certificados — e cada lado tem motivos para preferir um gatilho diferente.

segments.src: 5. **What happens to the fighters, not just the guns.** Demobilization programs that lack a livelihood or a policing role for former combatants tend to leak personnel into whatever armed structure remains. Any credible plan needs an answer on vetting, salaries, and legal status.
segments.tr: 5. **O que acontece com os combatentes, não apenas com as armas.** Programas de desmobilização que carecem de meios de subsistência ou de um papel policial para ex-combatentes tendem a vazar pessoal para qualquer estrutura armada remanescente. Qualquer plano credível precisa de uma resposta sobre triagem, salários e status jurídico.

segments.src: 6. **What non-compliance costs.** The hardest clause to draft is the one that penalizes a violation without handing either party a pretext to abandon the whole arrangement.
segments.tr: 6. **Quanto custa o descumprimento.** A cláusula mais difícil de redigir é aquela que penaliza uma violação sem dar a nenhuma das partes um pretexto para abandonar todo o acordo.

segments.src: ## The sequencing problem is not a detail — it is the deal
segments.tr: ## O problema do sequenciamento não é um detalhe — é o próprio acordo

segments.src: Both sides are currently insisting the other move first, and both have a coherent reason.
segments.tr: Ambos os lados estão atualmente insistindo para que o outro dê o primeiro passo, e ambos têm um motivo coerente.

segments.src: The Israeli argument is about capability: territory returned before weapons are verifiably gone can be used to reconstitute, and reconstitution is precisely what a disarmament agreement is supposed to prevent.
segments.tr: O argumento israelense é sobre capacidade: o território devolvido antes que as armas tenham sido comprovadamente removidas pode ser usado para reconstituição, e a reconstituição é precisamente o que um acordo de desarmamento deve evitar.

segments.src: The Palestinian argument is about leverage: arms handed over before withdrawal is complete removes the only guarantee the factions hold that the remaining stages will be honored at all.
segments.tr: O argumento palestino é sobre alavancagem: entregar armas antes que a retirada seja concluída remove a única garantia que as facções possuem de que as etapas restantes serão honradas.

segments.src: Neither position is unreasonable, which is exactly what makes it a security dilemma rather than a negotiating tactic.
segments.tr: Nenhuma das posições é irrazoável, o que é exatamente o que a torna um dilema de segurança em vez de uma tática de negociação.

segments.src: Agreements that have gotten past this point generally used the same toolkit: break the exchange into many small reciprocal steps so no single move is decisive; place weapons with a third party rather than with the adversary; put monitors on the ground early enough that both sides trust the reporting; and define milestones narrowly enough that compliance is a matter of observation rather than interpretation.
segments.tr: Acordos que ultrapassaram esse ponto geralmente usaram o mesmo conjunto de ferramentas: dividir a troca em muitas pequenas etapas recíprocas para que nenhum movimento isolado seja decisivo; colocar as armas com terceiros em vez do adversário; colocar observadores no terreno cedo o suficiente para que ambos os lados confiem nos relatórios; e definir os marcos de forma suficientemente restrita para que o cumprimento seja uma questão de observação, não de interpretação.

segments.src: Whether the roadmap uses that toolkit is the single most informative thing that will emerge in the next two weeks.
segments.tr: Se o roteiro usará esse conjunto de ferramentas é a informação mais reveladora que surgirá nas próximas duas semanas.

segments.src: ## What "verified disarmament" has meant elsewhere
segments.tr: ## O que o "desarmamento verificado" significou em outros lugares

segments.src: Comparisons are imperfect, but the record is instructive.
segments.tr: As comparações são imperfeitas, mas o histórico é instrutivo.

segments.src: In Northern Ireland, an independent decommissioning commission operated for roughly a decade.
segments.tr: Na Irlanda do Norte, uma comissão independente de desarmamento operou por cerca de uma década.

segments.src: Deadlines slipped repeatedly, and the process ultimately worked partly because the commission was permitted to confirm that decommissioning had occurred without publishing a full inventory — a deliberate ambiguity that let the armed group avoid the appearance of surrender.
segments.tr: Os prazos falharam repetidamente e o processo acabou funcionando em parte porque a comissão foi autorizada a confirmar que o desarmamento havia ocorrido sem publicar um inventário completo — uma ambiguidade deliberada que permitiu ao grupo armado evitar a aparência de rendição.

segments.src: In Colombia, a UN mission collected and destroyed FARC weapons on a timeline measured in months rather than years.
segments.tr: Na Colômbia, uma missão da ONU coletou e destruiu armas das FARC em um cronograma medido em meses, e não em anos.

segments.src: It benefited from conditions that do not obviously apply in Gaza: a single unified command that could order compliance, a negotiated political pathway for former combatants, and a monitoring mission both parties had accepted in advance.
segments.tr: Beneficiou-se de condições que não se aplicam de forma óbvia a Gaza: um comando único e unificado que podia ordenar o cumprimento, um caminho político negociado para ex-combatentes e uma missão de monitoramento que ambas as partes haviam aceitado com antecedência.

segments.src: Lebanon offers the cautionary case: repeated formal commitments to disarm non-state actors that were never implemented, largely because no institution existed with both the authority and the incentive to enforce them.
segments.tr: O Líbano oferece o caso de alerta: repetidos compromissos formais para desarmar atores não estatais que nunca foram implementados, em grande parte porque não existia nenhuma instituição com a autoridade e o incentivo para fazê-los cumprir.

segments.src: The pattern across all three is consistent.
segments.tr: O padrão nos três casos é consistente.

segments.src: Verified disarmament tends to succeed where there is a single chain of command that can deliver compliance, a political and economic future for the people being disarmed, monitors accepted by both sides before the clock starts, and enough face-saving ambiguity that compliance is not experienced as humiliation.
segments.tr: O desarmamento verificado tende a ter sucesso onde há uma cadeia de comando única que pode garantir o cumprimento, um futuro político e econômico para as pessoas que estão sendo desarmadas, observadores aceitos por ambos os lados antes do início do relógio e ambiguidade suficiente para salvar as aparências, de modo que o cumprimento não seja vivenciado como humilhação.

segments.src: It tends to fail where the receiving institution is weaker than the group handing over the weapons.
segments.tr: Tende a falhar onde a instituição receptora é mais fraca do que o grupo que entrega as armas.

segments.src: ## The fragmentation risk
segments.tr: ## O risco de fragmentação

segments.src: A framework signed by the major factions is not the same as compliance by every armed actor.
segments.tr: Um arcabouço assinado pelas principais facções não é o mesmo que o cumprimento por parte de todos os atores armados.

segments.src: Gaza's landscape includes smaller groups, family and clan structures with their own weapons, and criminal networks that have expanded during a prolonged breakdown of civil order.
segments.tr: O cenário de Gaza inclui grupos menores, estruturas familiares e de clãs com suas próprias armas e redes criminosas que se expandiram durante um colapso prolongado da ordem civil.

segments.src: Some of these actors have no signature on the document and no stake in it.
segments.tr: Alguns desses atores não têm assinatura no documento e nenhum interesse nele.

segments.src: A roadmap that treats "the weapons" as a single inventory held by a single authority may not match conditions on the ground.
segments.tr: Um roteiro que trata "as armas" como um inventário único sob o controle de uma única autoridade pode não corresponder às condições no terreno.

segments.src: That mismatch matters because it creates a predictable dispute later: incidents involving unaffiliated actors can be read by one side as evidence of bad faith and by the other as proof that the framework was never enforceable.
segments.tr: Essa inconsistência é importante porque cria uma disputa previsível mais tarde: incidentes envolvendo atores não afiliados podem ser interpretados por um lado como prova de má-fé e pelo outro como prova de que o arcabouço nunca foi exequível.

segments.src: Roadmaps that anticipate this — by distinguishing organized stockpiles from diffuse small arms, and by setting realistic expectations for the latter — are considerably more durable than ones that do not.
segments.tr: Roteiros que antecipam isso — distinguindo estoques organizados de armas leves difusas e estabelecendo expectativas realistas para estas últimas — são consideravelmente mais duradouros do que aqueles que não o fazem.

segments.src: ## What to watch over the next two weeks
segments.tr: ## O que observar nas próximas duas semanas

segments.src: - Whether the roadmap is published at all, or whether the deadline slips without a new date attached.
segments.tr: - Se o roteiro será de fato publicado ou se o prazo expirará sem uma nova data definida.

segments.src: - Whether it names the verification body and describes its access rights, or defers that question again.
segments.tr: - Se ele nomeia o órgão de verificação e descreve seus direitos de acesso, ou se adia essa questão novamente.

segments.src: - Whether the new Gaza administration is given identifiable staffing, funding, and a defined relationship to existing Palestinian institutions.
segments.tr: - Se a nova administração de Gaza receberá pessoal identificável, financiamento e uma relação definida com as instituições palestinas existentes.

segments.src: - Whether disarmament milestones are tied to specific withdrawal lines on a map.
segments.tr: - Se os marcos de desarmamento estão vinculados a linhas de retirada específicas em um mapa.

segments.src: - Whether any confidence-building step happens early — a first handover, a first pullback — before the full document is finalized. Small early moves are the most reliable predictor that a sequencing standoff will break.
segments.tr: - Se alguma medida de construção de confiança ocorrerá antecipadamente — uma primeira entrega, um primeiro recuo — antes que o documento completo seja finalizado. Pequenos passos iniciais são o indicador mais confiável de que um impasse de sequenciamento será quebrado.

segments.src: - Whether the language distinguishes heavy weapons from small arms. Frameworks that promise total disarmament tend to collapse; ones that prioritize strategic capability tend to survive.
segments.tr: - Se a linguagem distingue armas pesadas de armas leves. Arcabouços que prometem desarmamento total tendem a colapsar; aqueles que priorizam a capacidade estratégica tendem a sobreviver.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## A linha de fundo

segments.src: The framework's real achievement is that it replaced an argument about whether disarmament happens with an argument about how and in what order.
segments.tr: A verdadeira conquista do arcabouço é ter substituído uma discussão sobre *se* o desarmamento acontecerá por uma discussão sobre *como* e *em que ordem*.

segments.src: That is genuine progress, and it is also where the difficulty concentrates.
segments.tr: Isso é um avanço real e é também onde a dificuldade se concentra.

segments.src: Seven to eight months is an ambitious schedule for a process that has taken years elsewhere under easier conditions, and the two-week roadmap deadline is the first honest test of whether the parties are negotiating implementation or still negotiating position.
segments.tr: Sete a oito meses é um cronograma ambicioso para um processo que levou anos em outros lugares sob condições mais fáceis, e o prazo de duas semanas para o roteiro é o primeiro teste honesto para saber se as partes estão negociando a implementação ou ainda negociando posições.

segments.src: If the roadmap arrives on time and names a verifier, the deal is being built.
segments.tr: Se o roteiro chegar no prazo e nomear um verificador, o acordo estará sendo construído.

segments.src: If it arrives late, vague, or not at all, the framework will have documented the disagreement rather than resolved it.
segments.tr: Se chegar atrasado, vago ou não chegar de todo, o arcabouço terá apenas documentado a divergência em vez de resolvê-la.

segments.src: *This is an evolving diplomatic process, and specific terms, timelines, and participants may change as negotiations continue.
segments.tr: *Este é um processo diplomático em evolução, e termos específicos, cronogramas e participantes podem mudar conforme as negociações continuam.

segments.src: Readers should consult current reporting from established news organizations for the latest developments.*
segments.tr: Os leitores devem consultar as coberturas atuais de organizações de notícias consolidadas para obter os desenvolvimentos mais recentes.*

in.title: Kesepakatan di Atas Kertas, Kebuntuan di Lapangan: Tenggat Waktu 14 Hari Kini Berjalan untuk Lucut Senjata Gaza

segments.src: Signing is the easy part.
segments.tr: Penandatanganan adalah bagian yang mudah.

segments.src: The framework agreed to by Hamas and other Palestinian factions does something narrower — and more consequential — than end a conflict: it converts an open-ended question into a scheduled one.
segments.tr: Kerangka kerja yang disetujui oleh Hamas dan faksi-faksi Palestina lainnya melakukan sesuatu yang lebih sempit — dan lebih berdampak — daripada sekadar mengakhiri konflik: kerangka kerja ini mengubah pertanyaan yang terbuka menjadi pertanyaan yang terjadwal.

segments.src: Weapons are to be handed to a new Gaza administration rather than surrendered to Israel.
segments.tr: Senjata-senjata harus diserahkan kepada pemerintahan Gaza yang baru, bukan menyerah kepada Israel.

segments.src: Israeli withdrawal is to be traded, in stages, against verified disarmament over roughly seven to eight months.
segments.tr: Penarikan pasukan Israel harus ditukar, secara bertahap, dengan pelucutan senjata yang terverifikasi selama sekitar tujuh hingga delapan bulan.

segments.src: And the parties have given themselves about two weeks to produce the detailed roadmap that says how any of that actually works.
segments.tr: Dan para pihak telah memberi diri mereka waktu sekitar dua minggu untuk menghasilkan peta jalan rinci yang menjelaskan bagaimana semua itu benar-benar bekerja.

segments.src: That 14-day window, not the signing ceremony, is where the agreement will be tested first.
segments.tr: Jendela waktu 14 hari itulah, bukan upacara penandatanganan, tempat kesepakatan akan diuji pertama kali.

segments.src: ## What the framework commits to — and what it deliberately leaves open
segments.tr: ## Apa yang dikomitmenkan oleh kerangka kerja — dan apa yang sengaja dibiarkan terbuka

segments.src: Read plainly, the document establishes four things:
segments.tr: Jika dibaca secara jelas, dokumen tersebut menetapkan empat hal:

segments.src: - **A recipient for the weapons.** Arms are to be transferred to a new Palestinian administrative body in Gaza, not to Israeli forces or to a foreign military.
segments.tr: - **Penerima senjata.** Senjata harus ditransfer ke badan administratif Palestina yang baru di Gaza, bukan ke pasukan Israel atau militer asing.

segments.src: - **A trade structure.** Israeli withdrawal is sequenced against disarmament that a third party certifies, rather than either step happening unilaterally.
segments.tr: - **Struktur pertukaran.** Penarikan pasukan Israel diurutkan dengan pelucutan senjata yang disertifikasi oleh pihak ketiga, daripada salah satu langkah terjadi secara sepihak.

segments.src: - **A horizon.** Seven to eight months for the full process, which is fast by the standards of comparable disarmament efforts and slow by the standards of the political pressure on both sides.
segments.tr: - **Tenggat waktu keseluruhan.** Tujuh hingga delapan bulan untuk proses penuh, yang tergolong cepat menurut standar upaya pelucutan senjata yang sebanding dan lambat menurut standar tekanan politik di kedua belah pihak.

segments.src: - **A deadline for detail.** A concrete implementation roadmap within roughly 14 days.
segments.tr: - **Tenggat waktu untuk rincian.** Peta jalan implementasi yang konkret dalam waktu sekitar 14 hari.

segments.src: What it does not settle is nearly everything that determines whether the first three hold.
segments.tr: Apa yang tidak diselesaikannya adalah hampir semua hal yang menentukan apakah tiga hal pertama dapat bertahan.

segments.src: Frameworks are written to be signable; roadmaps have to be executable.
segments.tr: Kerangka kerja ditulis agar dapat ditandatangani; peta jalan harus dapat dijalankan.

segments.src: The gap between those two documents is where most disarmament agreements historically fail.
segments.tr: Kesenjangan antara kedua dokumen itulah tempat sebagian besar kesepakatan pelucutan senjata secara historis mengalami kegagalan.

segments.src: The choice of recipient is the clearest example of a compromise that postpones a fight rather than resolving it.
segments.tr: Pemilihan penerima adalah contoh paling jelas dari kompromi yang menunda perselisihan alih-alih menyelesaikannya.

segments.src: Handing weapons to a Palestinian body lets the factions describe the process as a transfer of national assets rather than a capitulation — politically survivable for a movement that has built its identity on armed resistance.
segments.tr: Menyerahkan senjata ke badan Palestina memungkinkan faksi-faksi menggambarkan proses tersebut sebagai pemindahtanganan aset nasional alih-alih sebuah kapitulasi — sesuatu yang secara politik dapat diterima bagi gerakan yang membangun identitasnya di atas perlawanan bersenjata.

segments.src: For Israel, the same arrangement raises the obvious objection: a transfer is only meaningful if the receiving institution is genuinely independent of the group doing the transferring, and genuinely capable of keeping custody.
segments.tr: Bagi Israel, pengaturan yang sama menimbulkan keberatan yang jelas: pemindahtanganan hanya berarti jika lembaga penerima benar-benar independen dari kelompok yang melakukan pemindahtanganan, dan benar-benar mampu menjaga pengawasannya.

segments.src: ## Six questions the roadmap has to answer
segments.tr: ## Enam pertanyaan yang harus dijawab oleh peta jalan

segments.src: If the two-week document is serious, it will have to be specific where the framework is not:
segments.tr: Jika dokumen dua minggu ini serius, dokumen tersebut harus spesifik di bagian yang belum dijelaskan dalam kerangka kerja:

segments.src: 1. **What counts as a weapon.** Rockets and launchers are the headline category, but the harder items are production workshops, drone components, dual-use machine tools, and the tunnel infrastructure that gives any of it strategic value. An inventory limited to visible hardware is a much smaller commitment than one that includes manufacturing capacity.
segments.tr: 1. **Apa yang dihitung sebagai senjata.** Roket dan peluncur adalah kategori utama, tetapi barang-barang yang lebih sulit adalah bengkel produksi, komponen drone, peralatan mesin guna ganda (dual-use), dan infrastruktur terowongan yang memberikan nilai strategis pada semua itu. Inventaris yang terbatas pada perangkat keras yang terlihat adalah komitmen yang jauh lebih kecil daripada inventaris yang mencakup kapasitas manufaktur.

segments.src: 2. **Who physically takes custody.** Sealed storage under monitoring, destruction on site, or removal from the territory are three very different outcomes with very different reversibility.
segments.tr: 2. **Siapa yang secara fisik memegang pengawasan.** Penyimpanan tersegel di bawah pengawasan, pemusnahan di lokasi, atau pemindahan dari wilayah tersebut adalah tiga hasil yang sangat berbeda dengan tingkat reversibilitas yang sangat berbeda.

segments.src: 3. **Who verifies, and with what access.** Verification is only as good as the monitors' freedom of movement and their acceptance by both parties. A body one side considers biased produces certifications the other side will not act on.
segments.tr: 3. **Siapa yang memverifikasi, dan dengan akses apa.** Verifikasi hanya sebaik kebebasan bergerak para pemantau dan penerimaan mereka oleh kedua belah pihak. Badan yang dianggap berpihak oleh satu sisi menghasilkan sertifikasi yang tidak akan ditindaklanjuti oleh sisi lainnya.

segments.src: 4. **What each Israeli withdrawal line is keyed to.** Withdrawal tied to calendar dates behaves very differently from withdrawal tied to certified milestones — and each side has reason to prefer a different trigger.
segments.tr: 4. **Ke mana setiap garis penarikan pasukan Israel dikaitkan.** Penarikan yang terikat pada tanggal kalender berperilaku sangat berbeda dari penarikan yang terikat pada pencapaian terverifikasi — dan masing-masing pihak memiliki alasan untuk lebih menyukai pemicu yang berbeda.

segments.src: 5. **What happens to the fighters, not just the guns.** Demobilization programs that lack a livelihood or a policing role for former combatants tend to leak personnel into whatever armed structure remains. Any credible plan needs an answer on vetting, salaries, and legal status.
segments.tr: 5. **Apa yang terjadi pada para pejuang, bukan hanya senjatanya.** Program demobilisasi yang tidak memiliki mata pencaharian atau peran kepolisian bagi mantan kombatan cenderung membuat personel bocor ke dalam struktur bersenjata apa pun yang tersisa. Rencana kredibel apa pun membutuhkan jawaban atas pemeriksaan (vetting), gaji, dan status hukum.

segments.src: 6. **What non-compliance costs.** The hardest clause to draft is the one that penalizes a violation without handing either party a pretext to abandon the whole arrangement.
segments.tr: 6. **Berapa kerugian akibat ketidakpatuhan.** Klausul yang paling sulit dirancang adalah klausul yang menghukum pelanggaran tanpa memberi salah satu pihak dalih untuk meninggalkan seluruh pengaturan.

segments.src: ## The sequencing problem is not a detail — it is the deal
segments.tr: ## Masalah pengurutan bukanlah detail — itu adalah inti dari kesepakatan

segments.src: Both sides are currently insisting the other move first, and both have a coherent reason.
segments.tr: Kedua belah pihak saat ini mendesak pihak lain untuk bergerak lebih dulu, dan keduanya memiliki alasan yang logis.

segments.src: The Israeli argument is about capability: territory returned before weapons are verifiably gone can be used to reconstitute, and reconstitution is precisely what a disarmament agreement is supposed to prevent.
segments.tr: Argumen Israel adalah tentang kapabilitas: wilayah yang dikembalikan sebelum senjata terverifikasi hilang dapat digunakan untuk memulihkan diri, dan pemulihan itulah yang justru harus dicegah oleh kesepakatan pelucutan senjata.

segments.src: The Palestinian argument is about leverage: arms handed over before withdrawal is complete removes the only guarantee the factions hold that the remaining stages will be honored at all.
segments.tr: Argumen Palestina adalah tentang posisi tawar: senjata yang diserahkan sebelum penarikan selesai menghilangkan satu-satunya jaminan yang dimiliki faksi-faksi bahwa tahap-tahap tersisa akan dihormati sama sekali.

segments.src: Neither position is unreasonable, which is exactly what makes it a security dilemma rather than a negotiating tactic.
segments.tr: Tidak ada posisi yang tidak beralasan, yang justru menjadikannya dilema keamanan, bukan sekadar taktik negosiasi.

segments.src: Agreements that have gotten past this point generally used the same toolkit: break the exchange into many small reciprocal steps so no single move is decisive; place weapons with a third party rather than with the adversary; put monitors on the ground early enough that both sides trust the reporting; and define milestones narrowly enough that compliance is a matter of observation rather than interpretation.
segments.tr: Kesepakatan yang telah melewati titik ini umumnya menggunakan perangkat yang sama: membagi pertukaran menjadi banyak langkah timbal balik kecil sehingga tidak ada satu langkah pun yang bersifat menentukan; menempatkan senjata pada pihak ketiga alih-alih pada lawan; menempatkan pemantau di lapangan cukup awal sehingga kedua pihak mempercayai pelaporan; dan mendefinisikan pencapaian secara cukup sempit sehingga kepatuhan adalah masalah pengamatan, bukan interpretasi.

segments.src: Whether the roadmap uses that toolkit is the single most informative thing that will emerge in the next two weeks.
segments.tr: Apakah peta jalan menggunakan perangkat tersebut adalah satu-satunya informasi paling informatif yang akan muncul dalam dua minggu ke depan.

segments.src: ## What "verified disarmament" has meant elsewhere
segments.tr: ## Apa arti "pelucutan senjata terverifikasi" di tempat lain

segments.src: Comparisons are imperfect, but the record is instructive.
segments.tr: Perbandingan memang tidak sempurna, tetapi rekam jejaknya dapat menjadi pelajaran.

segments.src: In Northern Ireland, an independent decommissioning commission operated for roughly a decade.
segments.tr: Di Irlandia Utara, komisi pembongkaran independen beroperasi selama kurang lebih satu dekade.

segments.src: Deadlines slipped repeatedly, and the process ultimately worked partly because the commission was permitted to confirm that decommissioning had occurred without publishing a full inventory — a deliberate ambiguity that let the armed group avoid the appearance of surrender.
segments.tr: Tenggat waktu berulang kali terlewati, dan proses tersebut akhirnya berhasil sebagian karena komisi diizinkan untuk mengonfirmasi bahwa pembongkaran telah terjadi tanpa mempublikasikan inventaris penuh — sebuah ambiguitas disengaja yang memungkinkan kelompok bersenjata menghindari kesan menyerah.

segments.src: In Colombia, a UN mission collected and destroyed FARC weapons on a timeline measured in months rather than years.
segments.tr: Di Kolombia, misi PBB mengumpulkan dan memusnahkan senjata FARC dalam linimasa yang diukur dalam hitungan bulan, bukan tahun.

segments.src: It benefited from conditions that do not obviously apply in Gaza: a single unified command that could order compliance, a negotiated political pathway for former combatants, and a monitoring mission both parties had accepted in advance.
segments.tr: Misi ini diuntungkan oleh kondisi yang tidak secara jelas berlaku di Gaza: satu komando terpadu yang dapat memerintahkan kepatuhan, jalur politik yang dinegosiasikan untuk mantan kombatan, dan misi pemantauan yang telah diterima oleh kedua belah pihak sebelumnya.

segments.src: Lebanon offers the cautionary case: repeated formal commitments to disarm non-state actors that were never implemented, largely because no institution existed with both the authority and the incentive to enforce them.
segments.tr: Lebanon menawarkan kasus peringatan: komitmen formal yang berulang kali untuk melucuti senjata aktor non-negara yang tidak pernah diimplementasikan, sebagian besar karena tidak ada lembaga yang memiliki wewenang sekaligus insentif untuk menegakkannya.

segments.src: The pattern across all three is consistent.
segments.tr: Pola di ketiga kasus tersebut konsisten.

segments.src: Verified disarmament tends to succeed where there is a single chain of command that can deliver compliance, a political and economic future for the people being disarmed, monitors accepted by both sides before the clock starts, and enough face-saving ambiguity that compliance is not experienced as humiliation.
segments.tr: Pelucutan senjata yang terverifikasi cenderung berhasil jika ada rantai komando tunggal yang dapat mewujudkan kepatuhan, masa depan politik dan ekonomi bagi orang-orang yang dilucuti senjatanya, pemantau yang diterima oleh kedua belah pihak sebelum waktu dimulai, dan ambiguitas jaga gengsi yang cukup sehingga kepatuhan tidak dirasakan sebagai penghinaan.

segments.src: It tends to fail where the receiving institution is weaker than the group handing over the weapons.
segments.tr: Pelucutan senjata cenderung gagal jika lembaga penerima lebih lemah daripada kelompok yang menyerahkan senjata.

segments.src: ## The fragmentation risk
segments.tr: ## Risiko fragmentasi

segments.src: A framework signed by the major factions is not the same as compliance by every armed actor.
segments.tr: Kerangka kerja yang ditandatangani oleh faksi-faksi utama tidak sama dengan kepatuhan oleh setiap aktor bersenjata.

segments.src: Gaza's landscape includes smaller groups, family and clan structures with their own weapons, and criminal networks that have expanded during a prolonged breakdown of civil order.
segments.tr: Lansekap Gaza mencakup kelompok-kelompok yang lebih kecil, struktur keluarga dan klan dengan senjata mereka sendiri, serta jaringan kriminal yang telah meluas selama runtuhnya tatanan sipil dalam jangka waktu lama.

segments.src: Some of these actors have no signature on the document and no stake in it.
segments.tr: Beberapa dari aktor ini tidak memiliki tanda tangan pada dokumen tersebut dan tidak memiliki kepentingan di dalamnya.

segments.src: A roadmap that treats "the weapons" as a single inventory held by a single authority may not match conditions on the ground.
segments.tr: Peta jalan yang memperlakukan "senjata" sebagai inventaris tunggal yang dipegang oleh satu otoritas mungkin tidak sesuai dengan kondisi di lapangan.

segments.src: That mismatch matters because it creates a predictable dispute later: incidents involving unaffiliated actors can be read by one side as evidence of bad faith and by the other as proof that the framework was never enforceable.
segments.tr: Ketidaksesuaian itu penting karena menciptakan perselisihan yang dapat diprediksi nantinya: insiden yang melibatkan aktor tidak terafiliasi dapat ditafsirkan oleh satu pihak sebagai bukti niat buruk dan oleh pihak lain sebagai bukti bahwa kerangka kerja tersebut tidak pernah dapat ditegakkan.

segments.src: Roadmaps that anticipate this — by distinguishing organized stockpiles from diffuse small arms, and by setting realistic expectations for the latter — are considerably more durable than ones that do not.
segments.tr: Peta jalan yang mengantisipasi hal ini — dengan membedakan penimbunan terorganisir dari senjata ringan yang tersebar, dan dengan menetapkan ekspektasi yang realistis untuk hal yang terakhir — jauh lebih tahan lama daripada peta jalan yang tidak melakukannya.

segments.src: ## What to watch over the next two weeks
segments.tr: ## Apa yang perlu diamati selama dua minggu ke depan

segments.src: - Whether the roadmap is published at all, or whether the deadline slips without a new date attached.
segments.tr: - Apakah peta jalan dipublikasikan sama sekali, atau apakah tenggat waktu terlewati tanpa ada tanggal baru yang dilampirkan.

segments.src: - Whether it names the verification body and describes its access rights, or defers that question again.
segments.tr: - Apakah peta jalan menyebutkan nama badan verifikasi dan menjelaskan hak aksesnya, atau menunda pertanyaan itu lagi.

segments.src: - Whether the new Gaza administration is given identifiable staffing, funding, and a defined relationship to existing Palestinian institutions.
segments.tr: - Apakah pemerintahan Gaza yang baru diberi staf, pendanaan, dan hubungan yang jelas dengan lembaga-lembaga Palestina yang ada.

segments.src: - Whether disarmament milestones are tied to specific withdrawal lines on a map.
segments.tr: - Apakah pencapaian pelucutan senjata dikaitkan dengan garis penarikan tertentu pada peta.

segments.src: - Whether any confidence-building step happens early — a first handover, a first pullback — before the full document is finalized. Small early moves are the most reliable predictor that a sequencing standoff will break.
segments.tr: - Apakah ada langkah membangun kepercayaan yang terjadi lebih awal — penyerahan pertama, penarikan pertama — sebelum seluruh dokumen difinalisasi. Langkah awal yang kecil adalah prediktor paling andal bahwa kebuntuan pengurutan akan terpecahkan.

segments.src: - Whether the language distinguishes heavy weapons from small arms. Frameworks that promise total disarmament tend to collapse; ones that prioritize strategic capability tend to survive.
segments.tr: - Apakah bahasa yang digunakan membedakan senjata berat dari senjata ringan. Kerangka kerja yang menjanjikan pelucutan senjata total cenderung runtuh; kerangka kerja yang memprioritaskan kapabilitas strategis cenderung bertahan.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: The framework's real achievement is that it replaced an argument about whether disarmament happens with an argument about how and in what order.
segments.tr: Pencapaian nyata dari kerangka kerja ini adalah menggantikan perdebatan tentang *apakah* pelucutan senjata terjadi dengan perdebatan tentang *bagaimana* dan *dalam urutan apa*.

segments.src: That is genuine progress, and it is also where the difficulty concentrates.
segments.tr: Itu adalah kemajuan nyata, dan di situlah juga letak konsentrasi kesulitannya.

segments.src: Seven to eight months is an ambitious schedule for a process that has taken years elsewhere under easier conditions, and the two-week roadmap deadline is the first honest test of whether the parties are negotiating implementation or still negotiating position.
segments.tr: Tujuh hingga delapan bulan adalah jadwal yang ambisius untuk proses yang memakan waktu bertahun-tahun di tempat lain di bawah kondisi yang lebih mudah, dan tenggat waktu peta jalan dua minggu adalah ujian jujur pertama apakah para pihak sedang mekerjakan implementasi atau masih menegosiasikan posisi.

segments.src: If the roadmap arrives on time and names a verifier, the deal is being built.
segments.tr: Jika peta jalan tiba tepat waktu dan menyebutkan nama verifikator, kesepakatan sedang dibangun.

segments.src: If it arrives late, vague, or not at all, the framework will have documented the disagreement rather than resolved it.
segments.tr: Jika tiba terlambat, samar-samar, atau tidak sama sekali, kerangka kerja tersebut hanya akan mendokumentasikan perselisihan, bukan menyelesaikannya.

segments.src: *This is an evolving diplomatic process, and specific terms, timelines, and participants may change as negotiations continue.
segments.tr: *Ini adalah proses diplomatik yang terus berkembang, dan ketentuan, linimasa, serta partisipan spesifik dapat berubah seiring berlanjutnya negosiasi.

segments.src: Readers should consult current reporting from established news organizations for the latest developments.*
segments.tr: Pembaca harus berkonsultasi dengan pemberitaan terbaru dari organisasi berita terpercaya untuk perkembangan terkini.*

ja.title: 文書上の合意、現場での対立：ガザ武装解除に課された14日間のタイムリミット

segments.src: Signing is the easy part.
segments.tr: 署名することは簡単な部分に過ぎません。

segments.src: The framework agreed to by Hamas and other Palestinian factions does something narrower — and more consequential — than end a conflict: it converts an open-ended question into a scheduled one.
segments.tr: ハマスやその他のパレスチナ派閥が合意した枠組みは、衝突を終わらせることよりも、より限定的で、かつより重大なことを行っています。つまり、未解決の問いをスケジュール化された課題へと変換したのです。

segments.src: Weapons are to be handed to a new Gaza administration rather than surrendered to Israel.
segments.tr: 武器はイスラエルに投降・引き渡されるのではなく、新たなガザ管理機関に手渡されることになっています。

segments.src: Israeli withdrawal is to be traded, in stages, against verified disarmament over roughly seven to eight months.
segments.tr: イスラエル軍の撤退は、約7〜8ヶ月にわたる検証可能な武装解除と引き換えに、段階的に行われることになっています。

segments.src: And the parties have given themselves about two weeks to produce the detailed roadmap that says how any of that actually works.
segments.tr: そして当事者たちは、これらが実際にどのように機能するかを示す詳細なロードマップを作成するために、約2週間の猶予を自分たちに与えました。

segments.src: That 14-day window, not the signing ceremony, is where the agreement will be tested first.
segments.tr: 署名式ではなく、この14日間の期間こそが、合意が最初に試される場となります。

segments.src: ## What the framework commits to — and what it deliberately leaves open
segments.tr: ## 枠組みが約束すること — そして意図的にあいまいに残されていること

segments.src: Read plainly, the document establishes four things:
segments.tr: 素直に読み解けば、この文書は4つのことを確立しています：

segments.src: - **A recipient for the weapons.** Arms are to be transferred to a new Palestinian administrative body in Gaza, not to Israeli forces or to a foreign military.
segments.tr: - **武器の受け取り手。** 武器はイスラエル軍や外国の軍隊ではなく、ガザの新しいパレスチナ行政機関に移管されること。

segments.src: - **A trade structure.** Israeli withdrawal is sequenced against disarmament that a third party certifies, rather than either step happening unilaterally.
segments.tr: - **交換の構造。** どちらかのステップが一方的に行われるのではなく、第三者が認定する武装解除に合わせてイスラエル軍の撤退が段階的に行われること。

segments.src: - **A horizon.** Seven to eight months for the full process, which is fast by the standards of comparable disarmament efforts and slow by the standards of the political pressure on both sides.
segments.tr: - **見通し（期間）。** プロセス全体で7〜8ヶ月。これは同様の武装解除の取り組みの基準からすれば迅速であり、双方に対する政治的プレッシャーの基準からすれば緩やかです。

segments.src: - **A deadline for detail.** A concrete implementation roadmap within roughly 14 days.
segments.tr: - **詳細の期限。** 約14日以内の具体的な実施ロードマップの作成。

segments.src: What it does not settle is nearly everything that determines whether the first three hold.
segments.tr: 解決されていないのは、最初の3つが維持されるかどうかを決定づけるほぼすべての事項です。

segments.src: Frameworks are written to be signable; roadmaps have to be executable.
segments.tr: 枠組み合意は署名できるように書かれるものであり、ロードマップは実行可能でなければなりません。

segments.src: The gap between those two documents is where most disarmament agreements historically fail.
segments.tr: これら2つの文書の間のギャップこそが、歴史的に大部分の武装解除合意が失敗してきた場所です。

segments.src: The choice of recipient is the clearest example of a compromise that postpones a fight rather than resolving it.
segments.tr: 受け取り手の選択は、争いを解決するのではなく先送りする妥協の最も明確な例です。

segments.src: Handing weapons to a Palestinian body lets the factions describe the process as a transfer of national assets rather than a capitulation — politically survivable for a movement that has built its identity on armed resistance.
segments.tr: パレスチナの機関に武器を手渡すことで、各派閥はこのプロセスを降伏ではなく国家資産の移管と表現することができます。これは、武装闘争の上にアイデンティティを築いてきた運動にとって、政治的に生存可能な選択です。

segments.src: For Israel, the same arrangement raises the obvious objection: a transfer is only meaningful if the receiving institution is genuinely independent of the group doing the transferring, and genuinely capable of keeping custody.
segments.tr: イスラエルにとって、同じ取り決めは当然の反論を引き起こします。移管が意味を持つのは、受け取り側の機関が移管を行うグループから真に独立しており、真に保管能力を備えている場合のみです。

segments.src: ## Six questions the roadmap has to answer
segments.tr: ## ロードマップが答えなければならない6つの問い

segments.src: If the two-week document is serious, it will have to be specific where the framework is not:
segments.tr: この2週間の文書が真剣なものであるなら、枠組みがあいまいな部分について具体的に示す必要があります：

segments.src: 1. **What counts as a weapon.** Rockets and launchers are the headline category, but the harder items are production workshops, drone components, dual-use machine tools, and the tunnel infrastructure that gives any of it strategic value. An inventory limited to visible hardware is a much smaller commitment than one that includes manufacturing capacity.
segments.tr: 1. **何が武器とみなされるか。** ロケット弾や発射台が注目されるカテゴリですが、より困難な項目は、製造作業所、ドローン部品、デュアルユース（軍民両用）の工作機械、そしてこれらに戦略的価値を与えるトンネルインフラです。目に見えるハードウェアに限定された目録は、製造能力を含む目録よりもはるかに小さなコミットメントにとどまります。

segments.src: 2. **Who physically takes custody.** Sealed storage under monitoring, destruction on site, or removal from the territory are three very different outcomes with very different reversibility.
segments.tr: 2. **誰が物理的に保管を引き受けるか。** 監視下の封印保管、現場での解体破棄、あるいは領域外への搬出は、可逆性が大きく異なる3つの非常に異なる結果です。

segments.src: 3. **Who verifies, and with what access.** Verification is only as good as the monitors' freedom of movement and their acceptance by both parties. A body one side considers biased produces certifications the other side will not act on.
segments.tr: 3. **誰が、どのようなアクセス権をもって検証するか。** 検証の有効性は、監視員の移動の自由と双方による受け入れ態勢次第です。一方の側が偏向しているとみなす機関が発行した認定書には、もう一方の側は従いません。

segments.src: 4. **What each Israeli withdrawal line is keyed to.** Withdrawal tied to calendar dates behaves very differently from withdrawal tied to certified milestones — and each side has reason to prefer a different trigger.
segments.tr: 4. **イスラエル軍の各撤退線は何に連動しているか。** カレンダーの日付に連動した撤退と、認定されたマイルストーンに連動した撤退はまったく異なる挙動を示します。そして双方には、異なるトリガーを好む理由があります。

segments.src: 5. **What happens to the fighters, not just the guns.** Demobilization programs that lack a livelihood or a policing role for former combatants tend to leak personnel into whatever armed structure remains. Any credible plan needs an answer on vetting, salaries, and legal status.
segments.tr: 5. **銃だけでなく、戦闘員はどうなるか。** 元戦闘員に対する生計手段や警察的役割を欠いた武装解除・動員解除プログラムは、残存する何らかの武装構造へと人材が流出する傾向があります。信頼できる計画には、適正審査（ベッティング）、給与、法的な地位に関する答えが必要です。

segments.src: 6. **What non-compliance costs.** The hardest clause to draft is the one that penalizes a violation without handing either party a pretext to abandon the whole arrangement.
segments.tr: 6. **不履行の代償は何か。** 最も起草が難しい条項は、どちらの当事者にも協定全体を破棄する口実を与えることなく、違反に罰則を科す条項です。

segments.src: ## The sequencing problem is not a detail — it is the deal
segments.tr: ## 順序立て（シーケンシング）の問題は細部ではない — それこそが合意そのものである

segments.src: Both sides are currently insisting the other move first, and both have a coherent reason.
segments.tr: 双方とも現在は相手が先に動くことを主張しており、双方ともに筋の通った理由を持っています。

segments.src: The Israeli argument is about capability: territory returned before weapons are verifiably gone can be used to reconstitute, and reconstitution is precisely what a disarmament agreement is supposed to prevent.
segments.tr: イスラエル側の主張は能力に関するものです。武器が検証可能な形でなくなる前に返還された領域は再構築に使用される可能性があり、再構築こそが武装解除合意によって防ぐべき事態です。

segments.src: The Palestinian argument is about leverage: arms handed over before withdrawal is complete removes the only guarantee the factions hold that the remaining stages will be honored at all.
segments.tr: パレスチナ側の主張は交渉力に関するものです。撤退が完了する前に武器を手渡してしまえば、残りの段階が確実に履行されるという派閥側の唯一の保証が失われてしまいます。

segments.src: Neither position is unreasonable, which is exactly what makes it a security dilemma rather than a negotiating tactic.
segments.tr: どちらの立場も不合理ではなく、だからこそ単なる交渉戦術ではなく安全保障のジレンマとなるのです。

segments.src: Agreements that have gotten past this point generally used the same toolkit: break the exchange into many small reciprocal steps so no single move is decisive; place weapons with a third party rather than with the adversary; put monitors on the ground early enough that both sides trust the reporting; and define milestones narrowly enough that compliance is a matter of observation rather than interpretation.
segments.tr: この段階を乗り越えてきた過去の合意は、通常、同じツールキットを使用しました。交換を多くの小さな相互のステップに分割して、単一の動きが決定的なものにならないようにすること、敵対者ではなく第三者に武器を預けること、両当事者が報告を信頼できるよう十分に早い段階で現場に監視員を配置すること、そして履行が解釈ではなく観察の領域となるようマイルストーンを狭く定義することです。

segments.src: Whether the roadmap uses that toolkit is the single most informative thing that will emerge in the next two weeks.
segments.tr: ロードマップがそのツールキットを使用するかどうかは、今後2週間で明らかになる最も情報価値の高い事実です。

segments.src: ## What "verified disarmament" has meant elsewhere
segments.tr: ## 他地域における「検証された武装解除」の意味するもの

segments.src: Comparisons are imperfect, but the record is instructive.
segments.tr: 比較は不完全ですが、過去の記録は教訓的です。

segments.src: In Northern Ireland, an independent decommissioning commission operated for roughly a decade.
segments.tr: 北アイルランドでは、独立した兵器廃棄委員会が約10年間にわたって活動しました。

segments.src: Deadlines slipped repeatedly, and the process ultimately worked partly because the commission was permitted to confirm that decommissioning had occurred without publishing a full inventory — a deliberate ambiguity that let the armed group avoid the appearance of surrender.
segments.tr: 期限は何度も延期されましたが、完全な目録を公表せずに廃棄が行われたことを認定することが委員会に認められたため、最終的にプロセスは機能しました。これは武装組織が降伏したように見えるのを避けるための意図的なあいまいさでした。

segments.src: In Colombia, a UN mission collected and destroyed FARC weapons on a timeline measured in months rather than years.
segments.tr: コロンビアでは、国連ミッションが年単位ではなく月単位のタイムラインでFARCの武器を回収・破棄しました。

segments.src: It benefited from conditions that do not obviously apply in Gaza: a single unified command that could order compliance, a negotiated political pathway for former combatants, and a monitoring mission both parties had accepted in advance.
segments.tr: これにはガザには明確に当てはまらない条件という恩恵がありました。順守を命じることができる単一の統一コマンド、元戦闘員のために交渉された政治的道のり、そして両当事者が事前に受け入れていた監視ミッションの存在です。

segments.src: Lebanon offers the cautionary case: repeated formal commitments to disarm non-state actors that were never implemented, largely because no institution existed with both the authority and the incentive to enforce them.
segments.tr: レバノンは警告となる事例を提供しています。非国家主体の武装解除という公式なコミットメントが何度もなされましたが、一度も履行されませんでした。その主な理由は、強制する権限とインセンティブの両方を持つ機関が存在しなかったためです。

segments.src: The pattern across all three is consistent.
segments.tr: これら3つの事例すべてに共通するパターンは一貫しています。

segments.src: Verified disarmament tends to succeed where there is a single chain of command that can deliver compliance, a political and economic future for the people being disarmed, monitors accepted by both sides before the clock starts, and enough face-saving ambiguity that compliance is not experienced as humiliation.
segments.tr: 検証された武装解除は、順守を実現できる単一の指揮系統が存在し、武装解除される人々の政治的・経済的未来が確保されており、時計が動き出す前に双方に受け入れられた監視員が存在し、順守が屈辱として受け取られないための面目を保つ十分なあいまいさがある場合に成功する傾向があります。

segments.src: It tends to fail where the receiving institution is weaker than the group handing over the weapons.
segments.tr: 一方で、受け取り側の機関が武器を手渡すグループよりも弱い場合には失敗する傾向があります。

segments.src: ## The fragmentation risk
segments.tr: ## 分断（断片化）のリスク

segments.src: A framework signed by the major factions is not the same as compliance by every armed actor.
segments.tr: 主要派閥によって署名された枠組み合意は、すべての武装主体による順守と同じではありません。

segments.src: Gaza's landscape includes smaller groups, family and clan structures with their own weapons, and criminal networks that have expanded during a prolonged breakdown of civil order.
segments.tr: ガザの状況には、より小さなグループ、独自の武器を持つ家族や一族の構造、そして長期にわたる市民秩序の崩壊中に拡大した犯罪ネットワークが含まれます。

segments.src: Some of these actors have no signature on the document and no stake in it.
segments.tr: これらの主体のいくつかは文書に署名しておらず、それに対する利害関係も持っていません。

segments.src: A roadmap that treats "the weapons" as a single inventory held by a single authority may not match conditions on the ground.
segments.tr: 「武器」を単一の権限によって保持される単一の目録として扱うロードマップは、現場の状況に合致しない可能性があります。

segments.src: That mismatch matters because it creates a predictable dispute later: incidents involving unaffiliated actors can be read by one side as evidence of bad faith and by the other as proof that the framework was never enforceable.
segments.tr: その不一致は後々に予測可能な争いを生み出すため重要です。非加盟の主体が関与する事件は、一方からは悪意の証拠として読み取られ、もう一方からは枠組みが最初から強制不能であったことの証明として読み取られる可能性があります。

segments.src: Roadmaps that anticipate this — by distinguishing organized stockpiles from diffuse small arms, and by setting realistic expectations for the latter — are considerably more durable than ones that do not.
segments.tr: 組織的な備蓄と拡散した小型武器を区別し、後者に対して現実的な期待を設定することによってこれを予見するロードマップは、そうでないものよりも格段に耐久性があります。

segments.src: ## What to watch over the next two weeks
segments.tr: ## 今後2週間で注目すべき点

segments.src: - Whether the roadmap is published at all, or whether the deadline slips without a new date attached.
segments.tr: - ロードマップが実際に公表されるか、それとも新しい日付が指定されないまま期限が過ぎるか。

segments.src: - Whether it names the verification body and describes its access rights, or defers that question again.
segments.tr: - 検証機関を指名し、そのアクセス権を明記しているか、それともその問いを再び先送りしているか。

segments.src: - Whether the new Gaza administration is given identifiable staffing, funding, and a defined relationship to existing Palestinian institutions.
segments.tr: - 新しいガザ管理機関に、特定可能な人員、資金、および既存のパレスチナ機関との定義された関係が与えられているか。

segments.src: - Whether disarmament milestones are tied to specific withdrawal lines on a map.
segments.tr: - 武装解除のマイルストーンが地図上の特定の撤退線と結びついているか。

segments.src: - Whether any confidence-building step happens early — a first handover, a first pullback — before the full document is finalized. Small early moves are the most reliable predictor that a sequencing standoff will break.
segments.tr: - 完全な文書が取りまとめられる前に、最初の引き渡しや最初の撤退など、信頼醸成のための初期ステップが行われるか。初期の小さな動きは、順序立ての対立が解消されるかどうかを示す最も信頼できる予測因子です。

segments.src: - Whether the language distinguishes heavy weapons from small arms. Frameworks that promise total disarmament tend to collapse; ones that prioritize strategic capability tend to survive.
segments.tr: - 文言が重兵器と小型武器を区別しているか。完全な武装解除を約束する枠組みは崩壊する傾向があり、戦略的能力を優先する枠組みは生き残る傾向があります。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The framework's real achievement is that it replaced an argument about whether disarmament happens with an argument about how and in what order.
segments.tr: この枠組みの本当の成果は、武装解除が行われるか*どうか*に関する議論を、*どのように*、そして*どのような順序で*行うかに関する議論へと置き換えたことです。

segments.src: That is genuine progress, and it is also where the difficulty concentrates.
segments.tr: これは真の進展であり、同時に困難が集中する場所でもあります。

segments.src: Seven to eight months is an ambitious schedule for a process that has taken years elsewhere under easier conditions, and the two-week roadmap deadline is the first honest test of whether the parties are negotiating implementation or still negotiating position.
segments.tr: 7〜8ヶ月というスケジュールは、より容易な条件のもとで他地域で何年もかかったプロセスとしては野心的なスケジュールであり、2週間のロードマップの期限は、当事者たちが履行に向けた交渉をしているのか、それともまだ立場についての交渉をしているのかを測る最初の真摯なテストとなります。

segments.src: If the roadmap arrives on time and names a verifier, the deal is being built.
segments.tr: ロードマップが時間通りに提示され、検証者が指名されれば、合意は構築されつつあります。

segments.src: If it arrives late, vague, or not at all, the framework will have documented the disagreement rather than resolved it.
segments.tr: 到着が遅れたり、内容があいまいに終わったり、あるいは全く提示されなかったりした場合、枠組み合意は不一致を解決したのではなく、ただ記録しただけということになります。

segments.src: *This is an evolving diplomatic process, and specific terms, timelines, and participants may change as negotiations continue.
segments.tr: *これは進行中の外交プロセスであり、交渉の継続に伴い、具体的な条件、タイムライン、参加者が変更される可能性があります。
